def brute_plan(caps, paths, benefits, pinned):
    n = len(paths)
    optimum = None
    best = None
    for mask in range(1<<n):
        if any(not mask >> i & 1 for i in pinned):
            continue
        load = dict.fromkeys(caps, 0)
        for i in range(n):
            if mask>>i&1:
                for v in paths[i]:
                    load[v] += 1
        if any(load[v]>caps[v] for v in caps):
            continue
        score = (sum(benefits[i] for i in range(n) if mask>>i&1), -mask.bit_count())
        if optimum is None or score>optimum:
            optimum, best = score, mask
    return optimum

# Reference replay independent of packed/short-circuit implementations.
def reference(req):
    flows = {f['id']:f for f in req['flows']}
    tables = {}
    active = set()
    results = []
    for ev in req['events']:
        op = ev['op']
        if op=='reset':
            active.clear(); results.append({'status':'ok'}); continue
        f = flows[ev['flow']]; fid = f['id']
        if op=='disable':
            active.discard(fid); status='ok'
        elif op=='enable':
            if fid in active or all(tables.get((v,l))==fid for v,l in zip(f['path'],f['labels'])):
                active.add(fid); status='ok'
            else: status='unready'
        elif op=='put':
            v=ev['node']; l=f['labels'][f['path'].index(v)]
            if tables.get((v,l))==fid: status='ok'
            elif any((v,l) in list(zip(flows[x]['path'],flows[x]['labels'])) for x in active):status='busy'
            elif (v,l) not in tables and sum(node==v for node,_ in tables)>=req['capacities'][v]:status='full'
            else: tables[v,l]=fid; status='ok'
        else:
            h=bytearray.fromhex(ev['header']); p=bytes.fromhex(ev['payload'])
            template=bytes.fromhex(f['template']); kinds=f['kinds']
            if fid not in active:mode,reason='ip','disabled'
            elif any(k=='K' and b!=template[i] for i,(k,b) in enumerate(zip(kinds,h))):mode,reason='ip','mismatch'
            elif h[kinds.index('Q')]>7:mode,reason='ip','qos'
            else:mode,reason='mpls','compressed'
            t=kinds.index('T'); q=kinds.index('Q'); ttl=h[t]
            wire=[]
            for i,v in enumerate(f['path']):
                if (i==0 and ttl==0) or (i>0 and ttl<=1):break
                if i>0:ttl-=1
                if mode=='ip':
                    h[t]=ttl; b=bytes(h)+p
                else:
                    label=f['labels'][i]
                    b=((label<<12)|(h[q]<<9)|256|ttl).to_bytes(4,'big')+bytes(h[j] for j,k in enumerate(kinds) if k=='D')+p
                wire.append(b.hex())
            if len(wire)<len(f['path']):delivered=None
            elif mode=='ip':delivered=wire[-1]
            else:
                new=bytearray(template)
                for j,k in enumerate(kinds):
                    if k=='D' or k=='Q':new[j]=h[j]
                    elif k=='Z':new[j]=0
                    elif k=='T':new[j]=ttl
                delivered=(bytes(new)+p).hex()
            results.append(dict(mode=mode,reason=reason,wire=wire,delivered=delivered,byte_hops=sum(len(w)//2 for w in wire)))
            continue
        results.append({'status':status})
    return dict(results=results,active=sorted(active),tables=[dict(node=v,label=l,flow=f) for (v,l),f in sorted(tables.items())])
